test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A cupboard was sold at a profit of 25%.Had it been sold at Rs.360 less, the profit would have been only 5%. What should be the selling price (in Rs.) of the cupboard, so that there is a profit of 40%?
solution:
**Given:**

A cupboard was sold at a profit of 25%

**Concept used:**

Selling price = Cost price + cost price × profit%

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of the cupboard be Rs. 100a

So, the selling price of the cupboard = Rs. 100a + 100a × 25%

⇒ 125a

According to the question,

125a - 100a + 100a × 5% = 360

⇒ 125a - 105a = 360

⇒ 20a = 360

⇒ a = 360/20

⇒ a = 18

So, cost price = 100 × 18

⇒ 1800

Now,

Required selling price = 1800 + 1800 × 40%

⇒ Rs. 2520

**∴ The selling price (in Rs.) of the cupboard, so that there is a profit of 40% is 2520.**
